title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Desk Reference Card — Deciding a Credit Line Increase Request
content:
A credit line increase requested by an owner or principal and recorded as a submitted credit line increase request is decided by Customer Care when the requested line does not exceed the tier's financials threshold, and the decision approves the request and sets the new line in one step.

## Scope

This card covers credit line increase requests on every Ridgeline Pro Credit tier, revolving and pay-in-full. The decision sizes the new credit line and books it together with the approval of the request. A request whose requested line is above the tier's financials threshold is not one Customer Care decides.

## Ledger state the decision waits on

A new credit line is not decided until the ledger shows a payment credited after the latest statement date that at least equals that statement's past-due amount.

## Booking the decision

The decision is booked by the agent with the task tool `decide_credit_line_increase_746194e9`. It is a hidden tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Capability.** One call decides a submitted credit line increase request on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account by approving it with a new credit line: it marks the request approved with today's decision date, sets the account's credit line to the new figure and records today as the date the line last changed. The business sees the new credit line on the account and the request as approved.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trade_account_id` | The reference number of the Ridgeline Pro Credit account whose line changes, as returned by the Pro Credit account lookup | Identifier |
| `trade_request_id` | The reference number of the submitted credit line increase request being decided, as returned by the Pro Credit service request lookup | Identifier |
| `new_credit_limit` | The new credit line | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places; set exactly as given |

### Return

On success the tool returns `status` "approved", `trade_request_id` (the request decided), `previous_credit_limit` and `new_credit_limit` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `credit_limit_changed_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). The tool's contract defines no other outcome.

### Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `trade_account_id` "TA-EXAMPLE", `trade_request_id` "TR-EXAMPLE" and `new_credit_limit` 13500.00 on an account whose line was 12000.00 returns `status` "approved", `previous_credit_limit` 12000.00, `new_credit_limit` 13500.00 and today's date as `credit_limit_changed_date`.
